name: AFRA 3619
title: History of the Caribbean
description: (Also offered as HIST 3619, LLAS 3619.) Encounter experience; slavery, antislavery mobilization, and abolitionism; colonialism; citizenship and nation building; race and gender; political cultures and movements; migration/immigration; cultural production; and political economy; topics will be examined from a historical perspective. CA 1. CA 4-INT.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
